item.title: GovBrief Today #569
item.description: The Prime Minister of Canada says America attacked his country. The 50% tariffs Trump long threatened hit at midnight Friday after US negotiators demanded in the final hours that Canada surrender its right to make trade deals with other nations. Canada stopped negotiating and set dollar for dollar retaliation for September 8. Asked why he sounded like a man going to war, Carney answered, "You're at war when you get attacked. We got attacked." Just hours ago, Trump posted his reason, "Canada wants the benefits of being a State, without being one!!!" The trade deal he destroyed was the one he negotiated during his first term and called the greatest ever made. His refusal to honor that deal started costing you more at midnight. item.title: Fuck me I guess
item.description: I basically got Darwin and Knux at the same time. They were a couple of months in age difference. He's been dealing with a chronic sinus infection since mid June and has lost a lot of weight. We did x-rays last week and they said there may be some growth in there. I have to weigh my options with him. There isn't much they can offer me being as he also, like Darwin, has a grade three heart murmur. They really don't want to sedate him to do a CT (which I can't afford anyways). I feel like I'm just watching him waste away. He's tired of me giving him meds everyday. I'm also tired of giving him meds everyday. They didn't even like each other! Why are they trying to die at the same time! Haha that's life I guess.

item.title: Passenger Princess
item.description:
We want to remember the good internet. The cat clips, the funny family tales, the great comic feats. The internet that makes us laugh. That's the internet we grew up on and the the one we want want to be a part of. We know that the world wide web is not always a great place. Its like we are full of contradictions. One moment you're laughing at a tortoise enjoying a fresh lettuce leaf, the next you stumble across some heinous hateful trash. Thats what it feels like to be online today. Your brain cannot stand this whiplash. Sometimes we want to throw our phones into the river and be done with it all. But then we remember you, our readers. And the good internet. And that its not time to give up just yet. If you want to support our work, here's the link: https://www.patreon.com/warandpeas
